newsitem.title: USA: Trinity Gas to drill 3 wells, explore.
newsitem.headline: Trinity Gas to drill 3 wells, explore.

text.p: Trinity Gas Corp said on Tuesday it plans to drill three wells over the next three months in addition to its recently successful Palmira 1 well in Colombia's Cauca Valley.
Trinity is applying to lease an additional 1.5 million acres in Colombia, the company said in a statement.

Currently, Trinity has 600 square miles under contract with the Farallones Association. Ecopetrol, the Colombia's national oil company, is an equal partner with Trinity in this contact, the company said.

Company officials said that technical and other engineering information regarding its discoveries in the Cauca Valley will remain proprietary until negotiations with Colombian officials for the additional leases are complete, the company said.
The company's interpretation of some of the well's technical data will be released later this week, it said.
